about: Labelled Agenda detection corpus (add-agenda task 1.1). Synthetic mail, calendar, meeting and Chat samples; every scenario exists in en, cs and de with the same labels. expected lists the user's commitments as inclusive local due-date ranges; an empty list means nothing belongs on the Agenda. Fields mirror the app's intake adapters (client/src/app/app.cpp, agenda_intake.cpp).

en.title: Project sync brake-by-wire
en.text:

Tomáš Král: Then the timeline needs an update.
Martin Weber: Jana, can you send the updated timeline to everyone by Wednesday?
Jana Nováková: Sure, I'll do it.
